name: Rohrer Corporation
old_description: Rohrer Corporation Expands Sustainable Material Options In Its ezCombo® Packaging Program
about:
Rohrer Corporation, headquartered in Warwick, Rhode Island, operates nine manufacturing facilities across the United States and Mexico. The company was founded in 1973 by John and David Rohrer as a family-owned packaging business. In 2021, private equity firm Wellspring Capital Management acquired Rohrer, adding to a growth trajectory that included acquisitions of CardPak (2016), Transparent Container (2018), Coburn Carton (2021), and Jay Packaging (2022).

Rohrer provides retail packaging solutions encompassing design and engineering, printing and thermoforming, tooling and machinery, and technical service assistance. Its capabilities include soft-touch coating, printing on a wide range of substrates, and production tooling. The company runs nine regional facilities in Wadsworth, OH; Hayesville, OH; Addison, IL; Bensenville, IL; Buford, GA; Huntley, IL; Warwick, RI; Mesa, AZ; and Tijuana, B.C., Mexico, though total headcount and annual volume are not disclosed.

The company serves medical and pharmaceutical packaging, cosmetic packaging, and consumer-goods brands. Notable customers referenced include Newell Brands (Sharpie Spinner Pack), Mars Fishcare, and CE Tools. Rohrer's ezCombo® and ecoCombo® programs target brand owners seeking sustainable, cost-effective packaging with rapid turnaround.

Rohrer differentiates itself through its ezCombo® program, which promises industry-leading speed, quality, and value, and its ecoCombo® program, described as the packaging industry's first post-consumer recycled materials combo offering. The company states a goal of zero product and service defects, 100% on-time delivery, and total customer satisfaction, backed by certifications including ISO 9001:2015, FSC Chain of Custody, and GMI Full Certification.
